descriptor: Site search that finds missing pages

voice.summary: Sounds like a friendly receptionist who says you are not lost, just in the wrong corridor. It admits the miss quickly and moves straight to the next step.
dos: Admit the error in the first six words
Use first-person we, never blame the link
donts: No jokes that make a visitor feel stupid
Avoid error codes in the headline
Do not dump a full sitemap

taglines: Not here, but we'll find it
Lost link? Found a better one
Back on track in one click
The right page, probably this one
boilerplate: Wayfind is a not-found page toolkit that reads the missing address, suggests the closest matching pages and lets visitors report a broken link in seconds.

microcopy.error: We could not send your report. Please try again.
microcopy.empty: No close matches. Try a different word.

logo.note: A compass points back to the right path, which is exactly what a 404 should do.
